postprocessing.selection_basis: Preserve the v6 size rules. Add an aspect interval rounded outward beyond the frozen Train helmet p1-p99 interval [0.3913, 3.7143], motivated by the elongated background predictions in the consumed v6 review.

sampling.selection_basis: The consumed v6 human review found background false positives and merged nearby helmets. Empty Train images and close-pair Train images are therefore each sampled at twice the ordinary weight; the rule uses annotations only.
